What is service code 0154?

Service code 0154 = ISD (Involving Subdivision).
  • What it is: a patta transfer in which the parcel is split, so a field inspection and a sub-division sketch are required.
  • Workflow: Citizen / CSC / Sub-Registrar → SIS (mandatory field visit) → Senior Draughtsman (SD sketch) → DIS → Tahsildar (DSC).
  • Fee: Government ₹400.00 + CSC charge ₹60.00.
  • SLA: 30-35 working days.
  • Field visit: required.
You are the SIS AI Assistant for Tamil Nadu Sub Inspector Surveyor officers. Answer only from the department's register; never invent an application number, count, or date.
What is service code 0153?

Service code 0153 = NISD (Not Involving Subdivision).
  • What it is: a straight patta transfer of the whole survey number — no new sub-division is created, so no field visit and no SD sketch.
  • Workflow: Citizen / CSC / Sub-Registrar → SIS (document verification) → Zonal Level Tahsildar (DSC signature, order generated).
  • Fee: Government ₹100.00 + CSC charge ₹60.00.
  • SLA: 15-20 working days.
  • Field visit: not required.

If the IGRS number is absent, does that mean it's not from the SRO?

An IGRS Form 6 number is raised only by the Sub-Registrar Office's (SRO) IGRS system, off the registered deed. So an application with no IGRS number did not come from the SRO — it was filed at a CSC / e-Sevai counter, or by the citizen at a revenue camp. For those two channels an empty IGRS field is the rule, not a gap in the record, and it is not something to chase up.

Who is the Sub-Registrar?

SRO is the Sub-Registrar Office, where a sale deed is registered. When a deed is registered there, its IGRS system raises the patta mutation off the registered document and issues an IGRS Form 6 number. An application that reaches the SIS desk that way carries that number and no operator code; the officer's own checks on extent and boundaries still apply.

What is a CAN number?

CAN is the Citizen Access Number — the unique identity number a citizen is issued and quotes on an application. If the IGRS number is absent, does that mean it's not from the SRO?

An IGRS Form 6 number is raised only by the Sub-Registrar Office's (SRO) IGRS system, off the registered deed. So an application with no IGRS number did not come from the SRO — it was filed at a CSC / e-Sevai counter, or by the citizen at a revenue camp. For those two channels an empty IGRS field is the rule, not a gap in the record, and it is not something to chase up.

Who is the Sub-Registrar?

SRO is the Sub-Registrar Office, where a sale deed is registered. When a deed is registered there, its IGRS system raises the patta mutation off the registered document and issues an IGRS Form 6 number. An application that reaches the SIS desk that way carries that number and no operator code; the officer's own checks on extent and boundaries still apply.

What is a CAN number?

CAN is the Citizen Access Number — the unique identity number a citizen is issued and quotes on an application. Its length names the counter that issued it: 15 digits (133 series) from a CSC / e-Sevai counter, 12 digits from the TN citizen portal. It does not by itself tell you the submission channel.
